Ref. No. ESDS / 2026-27 / 20 
 
Date: November 02, 2026 
 
To 
 
 
 
 
 
 
To 
Department of Corporate Services 
 
 
Listing Department 
BSE Limited 
 
 
 
 
 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
 
 
 
C-1, G-Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex 
Dalal Street, Mumbai, MH – 400001 
 
 
Bandra (E), Mumbai, MH – 400051 
Scrip Code: 544898 
 
 
 
 
Scrip Symbol: ESDS 
 
Sub: Submission of Audio Recording of Investor / Earnings Conference Call 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, please be informed that the Company has hosted an Investor / Earnings Conference Call with Investors 
and Analysts on Monday, November 02, 2026, wherein the Senior Management of the Company discussed 
the performance for the quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026, followed by an interactive question 
and answer session.   
 
In this regard, the audio recording of the said earnings conference call has been uploaded on Company’s 
website and can be accessed at this link https://www.esds.co.in/assets/images/investor-relations/Q2-
document/Earnings-Call-Audit-Recording.mp3  
 
Kindly take note of the same. 
 
Thanking you 
 
For ESDS Software Solution Limited 
 
 
 
(Prasad Deochand Deokar) 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer  
M. No. A34350 
 
PRASAD 
DEOCHAND 
DEOKAR
Digitally signed by PRASAD 
DEOCHAND DEOKAR
